predicates.title: Front Door / CDN endpoint without a WAF policy in Prevention mode
predicates.description: A Front Door or CDN front end has no associated Web Application Firewall policy, or the policy runs in Detection (log-only) mode rather than Prevention.
predicates.attack_vector: No edge enforcement -> direct application attack traffic reaches origin
predicates.recommendation: Associate a WAF policy in Prevention mode with the managed default rule set on every public front end.

query.kql: Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.cdn/profiles/afdendpoints' or type =~ 'microsoft.network/frontdoors' | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, endpointName=name, wafPolicyId=tostring(properties.webApplicationFirewallPolicyLink.id), wafMode=tostring(properties.policySettings.mode)

predicates.title: Application Gateway without WAF or in Detection mode
predicates.description: An internet-facing Application Gateway uses the Standard (non-WAF) SKU or runs its WAF in Detection mode, so malicious requests are not blocked.
predicates.attack_vector: No edge enforcement -> web application exploitation
predicates.recommendation: Use the WAF_v2 SKU with firewall mode Prevention and an up-to-date OWASP rule set.

query.kql: Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways' | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, skuTier=tostring(properties.sku.tier), firewallMode=tostring(properties.webApplicationFirewallConfiguration.firewallMode), wafEnabled=tobool(properties.webApplicationFirewallConfiguration.enabled)

predicates.title: Storage static website endpoint reachable directly
predicates.description: A storage account has static website hosting enabled and its account permits public network access, so the $web endpoint is reachable directly, bypassing any Front Door/CDN WAF in front of it.
predicates.attack_vector: Edge/WAF bypass -> direct content and app access
predicates.recommendation: Front the static site with Front Door + private origin access; restrict direct public endpoint reachability.

predicates.title: API Management gateway publicly exposed without VNet restriction
predicates.description: An API Management instance is exposed externally (publicNetworkAccess Enabled with virtualNetworkType None or External). The agent confirms whether APIs additionally lack subscription-key/OAuth enforcement or have open CORS.
predicates.recommendation: Require subscription keys or OAuth, restrict source IPs, and consider Internal VNet mode.

query.kql: Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.apimanagement/service' | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, publicNetworkAccess=tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess), virtualNetworkType=tostring(properties.virtualNetworkType)

predicates.title: Web edge allows weak TLS or no HTTPS redirect
predicates.description: A Front Door, App Gateway, or Static Web App custom domain allows TLS below 1.2, or an HTTP listener is present with no redirect to HTTPS.
predicates.recommendation: Enforce minimum TLS 1.2+, bind valid certificates, and redirect all HTTP to HTTPS.
